title: Daily Life - Ordering Chinese Food
audio: mp3/291. Daily Life - Ordering Chinese Food.mp3

segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: My name is Catherine.
segments.zh: 我叫 Catherine。

segments.en: And today we have a delicious lesson all about Chinese food for you.
segments.zh: 今天我们为您准备了一堂关于中餐的美味课程。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Today we are ordering Chinese food.
segments.zh: 今天我们点中国菜。

segments.en: Now for many of you listeners that are actually Chinese, you may not recognize these dishes because we are talking about American Chinese food.
segments.zh: 现在对于你们中的许多真正是中国人的听众来说，你们可能不认识这些菜肴，因为我们在谈论美国中餐。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So long, long ago, people came over to America from mainly Hong Kong.
segments.zh: 很久很久以前，人们主要从香港来到美国。

segments.en: And so a lot of the food we have is kind of more like Hong Kong food.
segments.zh: 所以我们的很多食物有点像香港的食物。

segments.en: Cantonese food.
segments.zh: 粤菜。

segments.en: Cantonese food.
segments.zh: 粤菜。

segments.en: But it's also very American.
segments.zh: 但它也非常美国化。

segments.en: So let's take a listen to today's dialogue and find out exactly what we're eating.
segments.zh: 所以让我们听听今天的对话，确切地找出我们在吃什么。

segments.en: Hi, welcome to Happy Buddha.
segments.zh: 嗨，欢迎来到快乐佛。

segments.en: Can I get you anything to drink?
segments.zh: 我可以给你喝点什么吗？

segments.en: Coke for me, please.
segments.zh: 请给我可乐。

segments.en: I'll have a Sprite.
segments.zh: 我要一杯雪碧。

segments.en: Okay, I'll go get that for you.
segments.zh: 好吧，我去给你拿。

segments.en: Are there any questions with the menu?
segments.zh: 菜单上有什么不清楚的吗？

segments.en: Do you use MSG?
segments.zh: 你们放味精吗？

segments.en: No ma'am, we are MSG free.
segments.zh: 女士，我们做菜不放味精。

segments.en: Oh man, I haven't had Chinese food in so long.
segments.zh: 哦，伙计，我这么久没吃中国菜了。

segments.en: I want everything.
segments.zh: 我全都要。

segments.en: This place has the best sesame chicken.
segments.zh: 这个地方有最好的芝麻鸡。

segments.en: Yeah, I've been craving Chinese for such a long time.
segments.zh: 是啊，我馋中餐已经馋了好久了。

segments.en: I used to get takeout all the time.
segments.zh: 我以前一直买外卖。

segments.en: It's definitely been a while.
segments.zh: 这肯定已经有一段时间了。

segments.en: Let's start off with some crab Rangoon.
segments.zh: 先来一份蟹肉奶酪炸馄饨吧。

segments.en: Oh yeah, that sounds good.
segments.zh: 哦，是的，听起来不错。

segments.en: I think I'm going to get the sesame chicken with fried rice, a spring roll and egg drop soup.
segments.zh: 我想要芝麻鸡配炒饭，再来一个春卷和一碗蛋花汤。

segments.en: It's so tempting to order everything on the menu.
segments.zh: 订购菜单上的所有内容真是太诱人了。

segments.en: It all looks so appetizing.
segments.zh: 这一切看起来都很开胃。

segments.en: I think I'll get General Tso's chicken, hot and sour soup, fried wontons and white rice.
segments.zh: 我想要左宗棠鸡、酸辣汤、炸馄饨和白米饭。

segments.en: Aren't you supposed to be on a diet?
segments.zh: 你不应该节食吗？

segments.en: You should at least get brown rice.
segments.zh: 你至少应该得到糙米。

segments.en: I don't think so.
segments.zh: 我不这么认为。

segments.en: I hate brown rice and I'm so sick of eating healthy all the time.
segments.zh: 我讨厌糙米，而且我一直厌倦了健康饮食。

segments.en: I've been eating so much salad, I swear I've forgotten what meat tastes like.
segments.zh: 我吃了这么多沙拉，我发誓我已经忘记了肉的味道。

segments.en: There's no better remedy than some nice, greasy, calorie laden Chinese food.
segments.zh: 没有比一些美味的、油腻的、富含卡路里的中国菜更好的补救措施了。

segments.en: I might even get an order of broccoli beef.
segments.zh: 我什至可能会得到一份西兰花牛肉。

segments.en: Oh gosh, I'm so hungry.
segments.zh: 哦，天哪，我好饿。

segments.en: Let's call the waitress over.
segments.zh: 让我们叫女服务员过来。

segments.en: Alright, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So obviously everything seems so good.
segments.zh: 所以显然一切看起来都很好。

segments.en: Very typical American Chinese dishes and we have a lot of things that we can take a look at so let's start with language takeaway.
segments.zh: 非常典型的美式中餐，我们有很多东西可以看，所以让我们从语言外卖开始。

segments.en: Language takeaway.
segments.zh: 语言要点。

segments.en: In language takeaway today, we're going to be talking about some general food words, words that you can use when you're ordering food.
segments.zh: 在今天的语言外卖中，我们将谈论一些一般的食物词，您可以在点菜时使用这些词。

segments.en: So the first one we should talk about is this MSG.
segments.zh: 所以我们应该谈论的第一个是这个消息。

segments.en: Right, Andrea asks, do you use MSG?
segments.zh: 对，安德里亚问，你用味精吗？

segments.en: So why is she asking this and what is MSG?
segments.zh: 那么她为什么要问这个，什么是味精？

segments.en: MSG is an ingredient in foods.
segments.zh: 味精是食物中的一种成分。

segments.en: It's kind of like a condiment, something that you put on the food after the food has been cooked and it makes the food taste better, brighter.
segments.zh: 它有点像调味品，你在食物煮熟后放在食物上的东西，它让食物的味道更好，更明亮。

segments.en: It intensifies the flavors a little bit.
segments.zh: 它稍微增强了味道。

segments.en: Yeah, and it's kind of, it looks like salt or sugar.
segments.zh: 是的，它有点像盐或糖。

segments.en: It's on the tables usually at Chinese restaurants but a lot of people don't like MSG because they don't think it's very safe for their bodies.
segments.zh: 它通常在中国餐馆的桌子上，但很多人不喜欢味精，因为他们认为这对他们的身体不太安全。

segments.en: And so actually the waitress says that the food is MSG free, which means there's no MSG in it.
segments.zh: 所以实际上女服务员说食物是无味精的，这意味着里面没有味精。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay, so she says our food is MSG free, which is this chemical.
segments.zh: 好的，所以她说我们的食物不含味精，这是这种化学物质。

segments.en: I think it's kind of like a chemical that you described.
segments.zh: 我认为这有点像你描述的化学物质。

segments.en: That's right and a lot of people don't want it.
segments.zh: 这是对的，很多人不想要它。

segments.en: So you can ask, is this food MSG free?
segments.zh: 所以你可以问，这个食物味精是免费的吗？

segments.en: You could also ask, is it fat free?
segments.zh: 你也可以问，它是无脂肪的吗？

segments.en: Is it salt free?
segments.zh: 它是无盐的吗？

segments.en: So this is a very helpful way of asking about what the ingredients are in a dish.
segments.zh: 因此，这是一种非常有用的方式来询问菜肴中的成分。

segments.en: That's right, that's right.
segments.zh: 没错，没错。

segments.en: And actually Manny is talking about the food as well and he says, yeah, I've been craving Chinese for such a long time.
segments.zh: 实际上，曼尼也在谈论食物，他说，是的，我一直渴望中国人这么久。

segments.en: Okay, so the verb here is to crave but he said he's been craving.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以这里的动词是渴望，但他说他一直渴望。

segments.en: So he really has been wanting this food for a long time.
segments.zh: 所以他真的想要这种食物很长时间了。

segments.en: So if you say I'm craving Italian food, what does that mean?
segments.zh: 所以如果你说我想吃意大利菜，那是什么意思？

segments.en: That means I really want to eat Italian food.
segments.zh: 这意味着我真的很想吃意大利菜。

segments.en: You feel like having Italian food.
segments.zh: 你想吃意大利菜。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So I'm craving some kind of food.
segments.zh: 所以我渴望某种食物。

segments.en: I really want to eat it.
segments.zh: 我真的很想吃它。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And he said that he used to get takeout all the time.
segments.zh: 他说他过去常常被外卖。

segments.en: So he's obviously talking about Chinese food.
segments.zh: 所以他显然是在谈论中国菜。

segments.en: What does he mean by takeout?
segments.zh: 他说的外卖是什么意思？

segments.en: Well, takeout is the opposite of sitting down in a restaurant and eating food.
segments.zh: 好吧，外卖是坐在餐厅吃食物的对立面。

segments.en: Takeout is what you do when you want to go home and eat it.
segments.zh: 外卖是你想回家吃的时候做的事情。

segments.en: So in many restaurants, you can order the food and you go and you pick up the food and you bring it home.
segments.zh: 所以在许多餐馆，你可以点食物，然后你去拿起食物，然后把它带回家。

segments.en: Okay, so that's takeout.
segments.zh: 好吧，那是外卖。

segments.en: So it's a noun.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个名词。

segments.en: You get takeout.
segments.zh: 你得到外卖。

segments.en: Right, but it's a little bit different from a different kind of takeout.
segments.zh: 对，但它与不同类型的外卖有点不同。

segments.en: There's takeout where you order the food and you pick it up and you bring it home.
segments.zh: 有外卖，你点食物，你把它拿起，然后把它带回家。

segments.en: But there's also delivery and delivery is when you order the food and someone else brings it to you.
segments.zh: 但也有送货和送货，当您订购食物并且其他人将食物送给您时。

segments.en: So be careful with those two.
segments.zh: 所以要小心这两个。

segments.en: All right, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: Moving forward, Manny kept talking about the food and said, wow, everything on the menu looks so appetizing.
segments.zh: 展望未来，曼尼一直在谈论食物并说，哇，菜单上的一切看起来都很开胃。

segments.en: It all looks so appetizing.
segments.zh: 这一切看起来都很开胃。

segments.en: Okay, appetizing is a way to describe something.
segments.zh: 好吧，开胃是描述某事的一种方式。

segments.en: In this case, we're describing food.
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，我们正在描述食物。

segments.en: So that's normally how we use the word appetizing.
segments.zh: 所以这通常是我们使用开胃这个词的方式。

segments.en: So appetizing basically means that you're excited about eating this food because it looks like it will be good.
segments.zh: 所以开胃基本上意味着你对吃这种食物感到兴奋，因为它看起来会很好。

segments.en: So what about the word appetizer?
segments.zh: 那么开胃这个词呢？

segments.en: Does this have anything to do with it?
segments.zh: 这跟它有关系吗？

segments.en: I think appetizer is something that makes you want to eat more.
segments.zh: 我认为开胃菜是让你想多吃的东西。

segments.en: That's why it's at the beginning of a meal.
segments.zh: 这就是为什么它在一顿饭的开始。

segments.en: You have your appetizer before you have your main course.
segments.zh: 在你吃主菜之前，你有你的开胃菜。

segments.en: But the word appetizing means that it's very appealing.
segments.zh: 但开胃这个词意味着它非常吸引人。

segments.en: You really want to eat it.
segments.zh: 你真的很想吃。

segments.en: It looks good.
segments.zh: 看起来不错。

segments.en: It looks delicious.
segments.zh: 看起来很好吃。

segments.en: Okay, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: And Andrea was worried because Manny is ordering so much food.
segments.zh: 安德里亚很担心，因为曼尼订购了这么多食物。

segments.en: She asks, aren't you supposed to be on a diet?
segments.zh: 她问，你不应该节食吗？

segments.en: Okay, so this is a phrase and I want to remind everyone to keep this phrase in mind.
segments.zh: 好的，所以这是一个短语，我想提醒大家记住这句话。

segments.en: You can diet, which is a verb, but in this case, you're on a diet.
segments.zh: 你可以饮食，这是一个动词，但在这种情况下，你正在节食。

segments.en: So it's a noun.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个名词。

segments.en: I'm on a diet.
segments.zh: 我在节食。

segments.en: I'm trying to eat healthily.
segments.zh: 我正在努力健康饮食。

segments.en: I'm trying to watch the things that I put in my body.
segments.zh: 我正在努力观察我放在身体里的东西。

segments.en: So usually if you're on a diet, you don't eat really greasy, fatty, take out Chinese food.
segments.zh: 所以通常如果你在节食，你就不会吃真正油腻、脂肪的东西，把中国菜拿出来。

segments.en: You eat salads and soups.
segments.zh: 你吃沙拉和汤。

segments.en: Okay, so you are on a diet.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以你正在节食。

segments.en: Yes, he's on a diet or I was on a diet, but I stopped.
segments.zh: 是的，他在节食，或者我在节食，但我停止了。

segments.en: Alright, a lot of great appealing food.
segments.zh: 好吧，很多很棒的食物。

segments.en: Why don't we go and listen to our dialogue again and we'll be back with Language Takeaway Part 2 where we're going to take a look at the specific American Chinese dishes.
segments.zh: 我们为什么不再去听我们的对话，我们会带着语言外卖第 2 部分回来，在那里我们将了解特定的美国中餐菜肴。

segments.en: Hi, welcome to Happy Buddha.
segments.zh: 嗨，欢迎来到快乐佛。

segments.en: Can I get you anything to drink?
segments.zh: 我可以给你喝点什么吗？

segments.en: Coke for me, please.
segments.zh: 请给我可乐。

segments.en: I'll have a Sprite.
segments.zh: 我要一杯雪碧。

segments.en: Okay, I'll go get that for you.
segments.zh: 好吧，我去给你拿。

segments.en: Are there any questions with the menu?
segments.zh: 菜单上有什么不清楚的吗？

segments.en: Do you use MSG?
segments.zh: 你们放味精吗？

segments.en: No ma'am, we are MSG free.
segments.zh: 不，女士，我们没有味精。

segments.en: Oh man, I haven't had Chinese food in so long.
segments.zh: 哦，伙计，我这么久没吃中国菜了。

segments.en: I want everything.
segments.zh: 我全都要。

segments.en: This place has the best sesame chicken.
segments.zh: 这个地方有最好的芝麻鸡。

segments.en: Yeah, I've been craving Chinese for such a long time.
segments.zh: 是啊，我馋中餐已经馋了好久了。

segments.en: I used to get takeout all the time.
segments.zh: 我以前一直买外卖。

segments.en: It's definitely been a while.
segments.zh: 这肯定已经有一段时间了。

segments.en: Let's start off with some crab Rangoon.
segments.zh: 先来一份蟹肉奶酪炸馄饨吧。

segments.en: Oh yeah, that sounds good.
segments.zh: 哦，是的，听起来不错。

segments.en: I think I'm going to get the sesame chicken with fried rice, a spring roll, and egg drop soup.
segments.zh: 我想我会买芝麻鸡配炒饭、春卷和蛋液汤。

segments.en: It's so tempting to order everything on the menu.
segments.zh: 订购菜单上的所有内容真是太诱人了。

segments.en: It all looks so appetizing.
segments.zh: 这一切看起来都很开胃。

segments.en: I think I'll get General Tso's chicken, hot and sour soup, fried wontons, and white rice.
segments.zh: 我想我会得到 Tso 将军的鸡肉、酸辣汤、炸馄饨和白米饭。

segments.en: Aren't you supposed to be on a diet?
segments.zh: 你不应该节食吗？

segments.en: You should at least get brown rice.
segments.zh: 你至少应该得到糙米。

segments.en: I don't think so.
segments.zh: 我不这么认为。

segments.en: I hate brown rice.
segments.zh: 我讨厌糙米。

segments.en: And I'm so sick of eating healthy all the time.
segments.zh: 而且我一直厌倦了健康饮食。

segments.en: I've been eating so much salad, I swear I've forgotten what meat tastes like.
segments.zh: 我吃了这么多沙拉，我发誓我已经忘记了肉的味道。

segments.en: There's no better remedy than some nice, greasy, calorie-laden Chinese food.
segments.zh: 没有比一些美味、油腻、富含卡路里的中国菜更好的补救措施了。

segments.en: I might even get an order of broccoli beef.
segments.zh: 我什至可能会得到一份西兰花牛肉。

segments.en: Oh gosh, I'm so hungry.
segments.zh: 哦，天哪，我好饿。

segments.en: Let's call the waitress over.
segments.zh: 让我们叫女服务员过来。

segments.en: All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So now let's take a look at those delicious American Chinese dishes on Language Takeaway Part 2.
segments.zh: 所以现在让我们来看看那些美味的美国中国菜，语言外卖第 2 部分。

segments.en: Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 语言要点。

segments.en: And so here we are with a number of delicious and very appetizing dishes.
segments.zh: 所以在这里我们提供了许多美味且非常开胃的菜肴。

segments.en: These are things that you'll normally find in an American Chinese restaurant.
segments.zh: 这些是您通常会在美国中餐馆找到的东西。

segments.en: The first one is called crab rangoon.
segments.zh: 第一种叫做螃蟹仰光。

segments.en: Okay, so this doesn't sound very Chinese at all.
segments.zh: 好吧，这听起来一点也不像中国人。

segments.en: Now rangoon is actually a city in a country called Myanmar or Burma.
segments.zh: 现在仰光实际上是一个叫做缅甸或缅甸的国家。

segments.en: And crab rangoon is a special deep-fried dish that's like, it's like deep-fried dumplings, but on the inside there's cream cheese and crab.
segments.zh: 螃蟹仰光是一种特殊的油炸菜肴，就像油炸饺子，但里面有奶油奶酪和螃蟹。

segments.en: Crab meat.
segments.zh: 蟹肉。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So it's kind of, as you said, like a dumpling, but inside you have cream cheese and crab.
segments.zh: 所以就像你说的，就像饺子一样，但里面有奶油奶酪和螃蟹。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: All right, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: Now, they also talked about getting the sesame chicken with fried rice.
segments.zh: 现在，他们还谈到了用炒饭买芝麻鸡。

segments.en: Okay, so sesame is a very common ingredient in cultures all over the world.
segments.zh: 好的，所以芝麻是世界各地文化中非常常见的成分。

segments.en: And sesame is a kind of seed.
segments.zh: 芝麻是一种种子。

segments.en: But some people also use some sesame oil in their cooking.
segments.zh: 但有些人在烹饪中也使用一些芝麻油。

segments.en: And so these all come from these white, small seeds.
segments.zh: 所以这些都来自这些白色的小种子。

segments.en: And sesame chicken is a kind of chicken that's cooked with sesame seeds.
segments.zh: 芝麻鸡是一种用芝麻烹制的鸡肉。

segments.en: Okay, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: And obviously we know what fried rice is.
segments.zh: 显然我们知道什么是炒饭。

segments.en: You just take, it's just basically rice in a pan with sometimes a little bit of meat and egg and just fry it all together.
segments.zh: 你就拿吧，它基本上只是一个平底锅里的米饭，有时还有一点肉和鸡蛋，然后把它们全部煎一下。

segments.en: But what about spring rolls?
segments.zh: 但是春卷呢？

segments.en: I think these are one of the typical Chinese dishes that everyone knows.
segments.zh: 我认为这些是每个人都知道的典型中国菜之一。

segments.en: And actually it's a Chinese dish as well.
segments.zh: 实际上它也是一道中国菜。

segments.en: I love spring rolls, although I've never gotten an American spring roll in China.
segments.zh: 我喜欢春卷，虽然我从来没有在中国买过美国春卷。

segments.en: The spring rolls we're talking about here are basically wrappers, these like wonton wrappers that are stuffed with meat and vegetables.
segments.zh: 我们在这里谈论的春卷基本上是包装纸，这些包装纸就像是塞满肉类和蔬菜的馄饨皮。

segments.en: And they're rolled up so they look like a long roll and they're deep fried.
segments.zh: 它们被卷起来，所以它们看起来像一个长卷，而且是油炸的。

segments.en: So okay, so spring rolls are, as you said, little rolls with meat and sometimes vegetable inside.
segments.zh: 好吧，正如你所说，春卷是里面有肉的小卷，有时是蔬菜。

segments.en: Not really sure why they call it spring roll though.
segments.zh: 不太确定为什么他们称之为春卷。

segments.en: I don't know either.
segments.zh: 我也不知道。

segments.en: Maybe it has to do with the ingredients, like they're vegetables from the spring.
segments.zh: 也许它与成分有关，就像它们是春天的蔬菜一样。

segments.en: Maybe.
segments.zh: 也许吧。

segments.en: Now, another one that I actually really, really like is this egg drop soup.
segments.zh: 现在，我真正非常喜欢的另一个是这个蛋液汤。

segments.en: This is delicious.
segments.zh: 真好吃。

segments.en: This is a very simple soup and when you're cooking it, you break an egg and the egg is mixed into the soup.
segments.zh: 这是一个非常简单的汤，当你煮它时，你打碎一个鸡蛋，把鸡蛋混合到汤里。

segments.en: So it looks like it's kind of got these yellow pieces floating, but it's a really nice simple soup with egg.
segments.zh: 所以看起来它有点漂浮了这些黄色的碎片，但它是一个非常好的简单的鸡蛋汤。

segments.en: Okay, and that's what it's called, egg drop soup.
segments.zh: 好吧，这就是它的名字，鸡蛋滴汤。

segments.en: Now you mentioned the wonton wrappers and they also mentioned fried wontons.
segments.zh: 现在你提到了馄饨皮，他们还提到了炸馄饨。

segments.en: What are wontons?
segments.zh: 什么是馄饨？

segments.en: Okay, wontons are also known as hundun in mainland China, but this is a special kind of dumpling.
segments.zh: 好吧，馄饨在中国大陆也被称为洪顿，但这是一种特殊的饺子。

segments.en: It's got a piece of dough basically that's flattened out and inside there's meat, maybe some vegetables.
segments.zh: 它有一块面团，基本上是扁平的，里面有肉，也许是一些蔬菜。

segments.en: And sometimes you eat it in soup, but here we're talking about fried wontons, deep fried wontons.
segments.zh: 有时你在汤里吃它，但在这里我们谈论的是油炸馄饨，油炸馄饨。

segments.en: So you put them in the deep fryer and they're fried so that they're crunchy and the insides are soft.
segments.zh: 所以你把它们放在油炸锅里，它们被油炸得很脆，里面很软。

segments.en: Actually, this is one of my favorite dishes.
segments.zh: 实际上，这是我最喜欢的菜肴之一。

segments.en: The original one in China though, as you said, the hundun, because it's like in a soup.
segments.zh: 正如你所说，最初在中国的，因为它就像在汤里一样。

segments.en: And it's very simple, but you have like dumplings in a soup, but the fried ones are also very, very good.
segments.zh: 而且很简单，但你有汤里的汤圆，但油炸的也非常非常好。

segments.en: They are both delicious and this is making me very hungry.
segments.zh: 它们都很好吃，这让我很饿。

segments.en: So maybe we should listen to our dialogue again.
segments.zh: 所以也许我们应该再听一次我们的对话。

segments.en: Hi, welcome to Happy Buddha.
segments.zh: 嗨，欢迎来到快乐佛。

segments.en: Can I get you anything to drink?
segments.zh: 我可以给你喝点什么吗？

segments.en: Coke for me, please.
segments.zh: 请给我可乐。

segments.en: I'll have a Sprite.
segments.zh: 我要一杯雪碧。

segments.en: Okay, I'll go get that for you.
segments.zh: 好吧，我去给你拿。

segments.en: Are there any questions with the menu?
segments.zh: 菜单上有什么不清楚的吗？

segments.en: Do you use MSG?
segments.zh: 你们放味精吗？

segments.en: No ma'am, we are MSG free.
segments.zh: 不，女士，我们没有味精。

segments.en: Oh man, I haven't had Chinese food in so long.
segments.zh: 哦，伙计，我这么久没吃中国菜了。

segments.en: I want everything.
segments.zh: 我全都要。

segments.en: This place has the best sesame chicken.
segments.zh: 这个地方有最好的芝麻鸡。

segments.en: Yeah, I've been craving Chinese for such a long time.
segments.zh: 是啊，我馋中餐已经馋了好久了。

segments.en: I used to get takeout all the time.
segments.zh: 我以前一直买外卖。

segments.en: It's definitely been a while.
segments.zh: 这肯定已经有一段时间了。

segments.en: Let's start off with some crab rangoon.
segments.zh: 让我们从一些螃蟹仰光开始。

segments.en: Oh yeah, that sounds good.
segments.zh: 哦，是的，听起来不错。

segments.en: I think I'm going to get the sesame chicken with fried rice, a spring roll and egg drop soup.
segments.zh: 我想要芝麻鸡配炒饭，再来一个春卷和一碗蛋花汤。

segments.en: It's so tempting to order everything on the menu.
segments.zh: 订购菜单上的所有内容真是太诱人了。

segments.en: It all looks so appetizing.
segments.zh: 这一切看起来都很开胃。

segments.en: I think I'll get General Tso's chicken, hot and sour soup, fried wontons and white rice.
segments.zh: 我想要左宗棠鸡、酸辣汤、炸馄饨和白米饭。

segments.en: Aren't you supposed to be on a diet?
segments.zh: 你不应该节食吗？

segments.en: You should at least get brown rice.
segments.zh: 你至少应该得到糙米。

segments.en: I don't think so.
segments.zh: 我不这么认为。

segments.en: I hate brown rice and I'm so sick of eating healthy all the time.
segments.zh: 我讨厌糙米，而且我一直厌倦了健康饮食。

segments.en: I've been eating so much salad, I swear I've forgotten what meat tastes like.
segments.zh: 我吃了这么多沙拉，我发誓我已经忘记了肉的味道。

segments.en: There's no better remedy than some nice, greasy, calorie laden Chinese food.
segments.zh: 没有比一些美味的、油腻的、富含卡路里的中国菜更好的补救措施了。

segments.en: I might even get an order of broccoli beef.
segments.zh: 我什至可能会得到一份西兰花牛肉。

segments.en: Oh gosh, I'm so hungry.
segments.zh: 哦，天哪，我好饿。

segments.en: Let's call the waitress over.
segments.zh: 让我们叫女服务员过来。

segments.en: Alright, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: As we mentioned, these dishes have a certain American influence to them.
segments.zh: 正如我们所提到的，这些菜肴对他们有一定的美国影响。

segments.en: They're not really spicy.
segments.zh: 它们不是很辣。

segments.en: I think that's the main difference as well.
segments.zh: 我认为这也是主要区别。

segments.en: American Chinese food doesn't really have the intense garlic flavor nor is it spicy like usual Chinese food.
segments.zh: 美国中餐并没有浓浓的大蒜味，也不像普通的中餐那样辛辣。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: I think that part of that is, like I said, due to the fact that a lot of the Chinese Americans who first came over came from Hong Kong.
segments.zh: 我认为其中一部分是，就像我说的那样，因为许多首次来的华裔美国人来自香港。

segments.en: And so Hong Kong food is not as famous for its spiciness.
segments.zh: 所以香港的美食并没有那么出名。

segments.en: It's not like Sichuan food.
segments.zh: 不像四川菜。

segments.en: You will see a lot of sweet sauces like this general sauce chicken is a very, very sweet sauce.
segments.zh: 你会看到很多甜酱，像这种普通酱鸡是一种非常非常甜的酱汁。

segments.en: You'll also see a lot of soy sauce in American Chinese cooking.
segments.zh: 你还会在美国中式烹饪中看到很多酱油。

segments.en: And so these are flavors that are very, very strong and they're not the same as the Chinese peppers and these spicy foods you get in China.
segments.zh: 所以这些味道非常非常强烈，与中国辣椒和你在中国得到的这些辛辣食物不同。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And actually there's one more dish that we didn't mention in the dialogue actually, but is very famous all around the United States.
segments.zh: 实际上，我们在对话中实际上还没有提到一道菜，但在美国各地都非常有名。

segments.en: It's called chop suey.
segments.zh: 它被称为切碎苏伊。

segments.en: Chop suey.
segments.zh: 切碎。

segments.en: And many people have argued about where the name comes from.
segments.zh: 许多人争论这个名字的来源。

segments.en: But chop suey is just basically like everything chopped up and fried together, right?
segments.zh: 但是 Chop Suey 基本上就像所有东西都被切碎和油炸在一起，对吧？

segments.en: It's like stir fried vegetables and meat.
segments.zh: 这就像炒蔬菜和肉类。

segments.en: And all put together in just a bowl.
segments.zh: 所有这些都放在一个碗里。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Well, my favorite thing about the American Chinese food that we get is that we get it in these little boxes.
segments.zh: 好吧，我最喜欢的关于美国中餐的东西是我们把它放在这些小盒子里。

segments.en: They're very cute.
segments.zh: 他们非常可爱。

segments.en: And you take them home and you open them up and every food has a box.
segments.zh: 你把它们带回家，你打开它们，每个食物都有一个盒子。

segments.en: And then at the end, you also get a fortune cookie, which is a very small cookie.
segments.zh: 最后，你还会得到一个幸运饼干，这是一个非常小的饼干。

segments.en: And inside there's a piece of paper.
segments.zh: 里面有一张纸。

segments.en: So don't eat the paper.
segments.zh: 所以不要吃纸。

segments.en: And the paper has a fortune for you.
segments.zh: 报纸给你带来了财富。

segments.en: It says, you will be very lucky today.
segments.zh: 它说，你今天会很幸运。

segments.en: Or your favorite number is 17.
segments.zh: 或者你最喜欢的数字是 17。

segments.en: And they're very cute.
segments.zh: 他们很可爱。

segments.en: Actually, you can see these boxes that Catherine mentions on our lesson page.
segments.zh: 实际上，您可以在我们的课程页面上看到 Catherine 提到的这些框。

segments.en: It's the lesson photo.
segments.zh: 这是教训的照片。

segments.en: And as you said, very, very common.
segments.zh: 正如你所说，非常非常常见。

segments.en: Each dish is put in this little box.
segments.zh: 每道菜都放在这个小盒子里。

segments.en: So if you ever get Chinese food, you'll see people carrying these little boxes around because they're very convenient and easy to carry.
segments.zh: 所以如果你吃过中国菜，你会看到人们随身携带这些小盒子，因为它们非常方便且易于携带。

segments.en: But the fortune cookie thing is also very common.
segments.zh: 但幸运饼干的事情也很常见。

segments.en: I was actually very surprised when I went to China and there were no fortune cookies.
segments.zh: 当我去中国时，我真的很惊讶，没有幸运饼干。

segments.en: It's weird, isn't it?
segments.zh: 这很奇怪，不是吗？

segments.en: I think it's funny because we expect these things to be very Chinese.
segments.zh: 我认为这很有趣，因为我们希望这些东西非常中国化。

segments.en: But in fact, when you come to mainland China, they don't have fortune cookies.
segments.zh: 但事实上，当你来到中国大陆时，他们没有幸运饼干。

segments.en: So I think it's a nice surprise but also kind of confusing.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这是一个很好的惊喜，但也有点令人困惑。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Well, a very interesting topic.
segments.zh: 嗯，一个非常有趣的话题。

segments.en: And in the future, we're going to continue doing different lessons about different cuisines.
segments.zh: 在未来，我们将继续对不同的美食进行不同的课程。

segments.en: We have Italian food coming up sometime soon.
segments.zh: 我们很快就会有意大利菜出现。

segments.en: So that's going to be very good as well.
segments.zh: 所以这也会很好。

segments.en: And of course, if you have any lesson suggestions or maybe you want to suggest the cuisine from your country, you can visit our website englishpod.com and leave your comments there.
segments.zh: 当然，如果您有任何课程建议，或者您想推荐您所在国家/地区的美食，您可以访问我们的网站 englishpod.com 并在那里留下您的评论。

segments.en: We hope to see you guys there and until next time.
segments.zh: 我们希望在那里见到你们，直到下一次。

segments.en: Bye, everyone.
segments.zh: 大家再见。
